criterion: 示範不同平台與路徑的配置策略，不將 MCU 等同禁 heap 或 PC 等同無限制。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: A PC deadline path uses a preallocated pool; an MCU best-effort initialization path uses its budgeted heap. Required finding for the counterexample: Selecting by PC/MCU label alone misses MEM-ALLOC-001 applicability.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
